title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Full Stack Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Responsible for developing and/or engineering the end\-to\-end features of a system, from user experience to backend code. Use development skills to deliver innovative solutions that help our clients improve the services they provide. Leverage new technologies that can be applied to solve challenging business problems with a cloud first and agile mindset.
  

**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves designing, building, and refining comprehensive system features that span from the user interface to the backend infrastructure. This role requires actively engaging in the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with various teams to ensure seamless integration and functionality. The engineer continuously explores and applies emerging technologies to address complex business challenges, all while maintaining a focus on delivering high\-quality, user\-centric solutions within an agile and cloud\-first environment.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead efforts to identify and implement process improvements that enhance team productivity and product quality.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and skill development.
* Coordinate cross\-functional communication to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Java Full Stack Development.
* Strong knowledge of front\-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks.
* Experience with backend development using Java and related frameworks.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services to support scalable application deployment.
* Understanding of agile methodologies and continuous integration/continuous deployment practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot and optimize application performance across the stack.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 8 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.


\- This position is based at our MDC5C \- SEZ office.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

title: Vice President, Full-Stack Engineer
description:
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:


* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain full stack applications that support applied AI solutions, enterprise platform capabilities, and AI\-enabled product flows.
* The Vice President, Full Stack AI Developer will work closely with product managers, product owners, engineering leads, data scientists, platform teams, and governance partners to translate product needs into high\-quality technical solutions. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical AI fluency, disciplined execution, and the ability to contribute across solution delivery, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and ongoing platform support.
* Support applied AI solution delivery by integrating AI/ML capabilities, model outputs, prompts, automation workflows, data services, APIs, and enterprise systems into reliable product experiences.
* Provide platform support for AI capabilities, including enhancements, defect resolution, release support, troubleshooting, performance improvements, and maintainability.
* Support AI product enhancement across platforms by improving existing workflows, adding new capabilities, integrating reusable components, and ensuring solutions scale across business and technology environments.
* Partner with product owners, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to translate requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and working software.
* Develop well\-designed, testable, efficient, and maintainable code to solve business and technology problems.
* Participate in solution design, code reviews, technical documentation, testing, release planning, deployment activities, and production readiness.
* Support application quality through automated testing, software verification, debugging, performance tuning, and secure coding practices.
* Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and enhance existing systems while managing technical debt and improving software maintainability.
* Ensure software solutions are aligned to enterprise architecture, security, privacy, resiliency, observability, and change management standards.
* Leverage existing products, reusable components, and platform capabilities to improve engineering efficiency and avoid duplication.
* Collaborate across product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams to deliver high\-quality AI\-enabled capabilities.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:


* Preferred 10\+ years of experience in software development, full stack engineering, application development, platform support, or related technology roles.
* Experience developing, supporting, and enhancing enterprise applications using modern application, API, integration, and platform technologies.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle practices, Agile delivery, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release management, and production support.
* Experience building secure, scalable, testable, and maintainable software in complex enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled applications, automation platforms, data\-driven products, model integrations, prompt\-based workflows, or AI/ML\-enabled software solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including debugging application behavior, reviewing logs, resolving defects, and improving application reliability.
* Understanding of security, privacy, performance, resiliency, and maintainability considerations in enterprise software development.
* Ability to work effectively with product, engineering, data science, platform, operations, risk, and governance teams.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, ownership, and collaboration skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required.
* Experience in financial services, enterprise technology, or another highly regulated environment.
* Exposure to generative AI, large language models, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, AI\-assisted development, or enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience with cloud platforms, containerization, microservices, DevOps tooling, observability, APIs, data integrations, and production support practices.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL / NoSQL databases, APIs, and modern engineering toolchains.
* Familiarity with AI observability, workflow automation, prompt orchestration, model lifecycle tooling, or data pipeline integration is a plus.

title: Senior .NET Full Stack Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!


Our people make all the difference in our success.


Our mission as a business focused technology organization is to provide best\-in\-class products and services to our global clients. ISG is focused on building a cross\-functional team of talented professionalsand creating a unique platform to deliver products that will disrupt the industry through technical innovation and creativity.


CODST Technology is looking for an experienced **Apps Dev Intermediate Programmer Analyst.**


**We are looking for an avid technologist who** \-


* applies analytical thinking and knowledge of development methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information.
* deals with most problems proactively and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in\-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid grasp of industry standards and practices.
* typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact.
* applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner.
* with a developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex information.
* can be moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

**Here is what you bring \-**


* You have **6\+ years** of experience in developing \& managing applications.
* You are expert in logical thinking and coding.
* You are expert in C\#, .NET, .NET Core 2\+, Angular 16\+, SQL, Python
  

**C\#**: Advanced knowledge in object\-oriented programming, LINQ, and asynchronous programming.
* **.NET Framework \& .NET Core (2\+)**: Strong experience in building scalable, high\-performance applications.
* **ASP.NET Core**: Expertise in developing RESTful APIs, middleware, and dependency injection.
* **Entity Framework Core**: Proficient in database\-first and code\-first approaches for data access.
* **Microservices Architecture**: Strong understanding of designing and implementing microservices using .NET Core.
* **Windows Services**: Experience in creating and managing background services.
* **Unit Testing**: Proficient in testing frameworks like xUnit, NUnit, and Moq for .NET applications.
* **Dependency Injection**: Expertise in implementing DI patterns for loosely coupled architecture.
* **Logging**: Experience with Serilog, NLog, and Microsoft.Extensions.Logging for application monitoring.
* You have strong experience in Rest API, Kafka/Messaging queue
  

You have strong experience in JQuery, JSON, HTML and CSS
* You have experience in installing, configuring or supporting business applications
* You have experience working with Efficiency Tools JIRA, Bitbucket, uDeploy
* You have exposure to ECS, CICD Pipelines
* You have exposure to AI tools \& agents
* You have exposure to BigData/Hadoop
* You possess advanced execution capabilities and ability to adjust quickly to changes, especially in prioritization
* You have excellent writing and communication skills, with a knack for taking technical language and making it comprehensible
* You have a passion for solving tough problems and proposing elegant solutions.
* You are an avid learner with an ability to learn and adapt so that you can help teach others and encourage idea exchange and information percolation

**On a typical day here is what you could do \-**


* You will provide technical and business supportfor users of Citi Applications. This includes providing quick resolutions to app issues, driving stability, efficiency and effectiveness improvements to help us and the business succeed.
* You will act as a liaison between users/traders, interfacing internal technology groups and vendors and as an advisor or coach to new or junior analysts.
* You will participate in application releases, from development, testing and deployment into production. Perform post release checkouts after application releases and infrastructure updates. Develop and maintain technical documentation.
* You will maintain application systems that have completed the development stage and are running in the daily operations of the firm.
* You will manage, maintain and supportapplications and their operating environments, focusing on stability, quality and functionality against service level expectations.
* You will assist in appropriately assessing risks when business decisionsare made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree /B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech or equivalent combination of technical education and work experience

**Why choose Citi:**


* Over 200 years in business with a great team of creative, visionary and entrepreneurial thinkers.
* Tremendous opportunities to advance, open to everyone across all levels. Learn and grow simultaneously!
* We offer a unique journey of personal and professional development, accomplishment and satisfaction.
* We value intelligence and a global mindset. There is a strong culture of empowerment here – we embrace diversity.
* We do our best to be flexible and may differ depending on the business or area.
* Citi India supports would be and returning mothers with various child care benefits.
* Citi offers a robust training program. We continually reevaluate our training model to ensure that we are always offering the most relevant and best in class training.
* At Citi, we value internal mobility. We want you to build a long\-term career with us, so you can expect opportunities to move around the organization.

**Competencies :**


* Requires good communication, presentation and written skills
* Ability to think Out of the box for any given business requirement
* Act as a change agent to drive innovation

title: Python Full Stack Developer(exp:5+yr)
description:
We are looking for an experienced **Python Full Stack Developer with 5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in **Python backend development, REST APIs, databases, and modern frontend technologies**.

The candidate will be responsible for developing end\-to\-end applications, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, troubleshooting production issues, and delivering high\-quality, scalable, and secure solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable full\-stack web applications using **Python**.
* Develop robust and secure backend services and **RESTful APIs**.
* Work with Python frameworks such as **Django, Flask, or FastAPI**.
* Develop responsive and user\-friendly frontend applications using **React.js, Angular, or similar technologies**.
* Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and third\-party services.
* Design and optimize database schemas, queries, and data models.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases such as **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB**, etc.
* Implement authentication, authorization, role\-based access control, and application security best practices.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-documented code.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Participate in code reviews and follow established development standards.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application and production issues.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and other developers.
* Work with **Git\-based version control** and CI/CD processes.
* Contribute to system design, technical documentation, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure applications are scalable, reliable, and optimized for performance.

Required SkillsBackend

* Strong proficiency in **Python**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Django / Flask / FastAPI**.
* Strong understanding of **REST API development and integration**.
* Experience with authentication mechanisms such as **JWT, OAuth, or session\-based authentication**.
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and design patterns.

Frontend

* Strong hands\-on experience with **React.js, Angular, or similar frontend frameworks**.
* Good knowledge of **JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3**.
* Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs.
* Understanding of responsive web application development.

Database

* Strong experience with **SQL databases**, preferably PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Experience writing optimized SQL queries.
* Good understanding of database design, indexing, relationships, and transactions.
* Exposure to **MongoDB or other NoSQL databases** is an advantage.

Tools \& DevOps

* Strong experience with **Git/GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Exposure to **Docker and containerization**.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as **AWS, Azure, or GCP** is preferred.
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments is a plus.

Good to Have

* Experience with **AWS/Azure/GCP**.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture.
* Experience with **Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ, or Kafka**.
* Understanding of asynchronous programming in Python.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks such as **PyTest or unittest**.
* Knowledge of system design and application scalability.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related field.
* Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.

Required Experience

* **5\+ years of professional software development experience**.
* Strong hands\-on experience in **Python Full Stack Development**.
* Proven experience developing and deploying production\-grade web applications.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

Preferred Tech Stack

**Python \| Django / Flask / FastAPI \| React.js / Angular \| JavaScript / TypeScript \| REST APIs \| PostgreSQL / MySQL \| MongoDB \| Git \| Docker \| CI/CD \| AWS / Azure / GCP**

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹120,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
